passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the other sections of this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the consolidated financial statements and related notes contained in Item 8, and the discussion of risks and cautionary factors that may affect future results in Item 1A. Risk Factors . Description of Our Company We are a leading international consumer goods company, actively delivering a smoke-free future. We are evolving our portfolio for the long term to include products outside of the tobacco and nicotine sector. Our current product portfolio primarily consists of cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, nicotine pouch and e-vapor products. Since 2008, we have invested over $16 billion to develop, scientifically substantiate and commercialize innovative smoke-free products for adults who would otherwise continue to smoke, with the goal of completely ending the sale of cigarettes. This investment includes the building of world-class scientific assessment capabilities, notably in the areas of pre-clinical systems toxicology, clinical and behavioral research, as well as post-market studies. In November 2022, we acquired Swedish Match AB ("Swedish Match") – a leader in oral nicotine delivery – creating a global smoke-free combination led by the companies’ IQOS and ZYN brands. As of April 30, 2024, we hold the full rights to commercialize IQOS in the U.S. after reaching an agreement to end our U.S. commercial relationship covering IQOS with Altria Group, Inc. in 2022. Following a robust science-based review, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") has authorized the marketing of Swedish Match’s General snus and ZYN nicotine pouches and versions of PMI’s IQOS devices and consumables - the first-ever such authorizations in their respective categories. Versions of IQOS devices and consumables and General snus also obtained the first-ever Modified Risk Tobacco Product ("MRTP") authorizations from the FDA. We describe the MRTP orders in more detail in the "Business Environment" section of this Item 7. Following the sale of Vectura Group Ltd. on December 31, 2024, we updated our segment reporting in January 2025 by including the ongoing Wellness results (previously referred to as Wellness & Healthcare) in the Europe segment. In addition, we renamed our “PMI Duty Free” business to “PMI Global Travel Retail” effective in the first quarter of 2025. As a result of this change, our segment that includes our duty free business was renamed East Asia, Australia & PMI Global Travel Retail (“EA, AU & PMI GTR”). As of December 31, 2025, our four geographical segments were as follows: • Europe Region, including our Wellness business; • South and Southeast Asia, Commonwealth of Independent States, Middle East and Africa Region ("SSEA, CIS & MEA"); • East Asia, Australia, and PMI Global Travel Retail (“EA, AU & PMI GTR”); and • Americas Region. As communicated in the fourth quarter of 2025, with our smoke-free business now operating at scale across our regions, including substantial growth from our U.S. business, we have implemented an evolved organizational model with two primary business units: International

credit_strengths.text: Operating margin is roughly double the consumer staples sector median and improved year over year, reflecting pricing power in cigarettes and the scaling smoke-free portfolio. This earnings quality underpins cash generation and cushions the fixed-cost base against volume declines in combustibles.

Interest coverage improved year over year and sits comfortably above the sector median, with operating income covering gross interest expense many times over. Headroom to the next risk band remains adequate, though the indicative profile is constrained by cash flow rather than earnings.

key_risks.text: Gross and net leverage sit modestly above sector medians even as both eased year over year, leaving thin headroom to the next risk-band boundary. A moderate EBITDA decline or incremental debt would push the indicative profile lower, so deleveraging discipline matters.

The business remains exposed to regulatory and litigation risk inherent in tobacco and nicotine products, and the disclosure warns that not all risk factors can be predicted. Continued investment to commercialize smoke-free products, including the Swedish Match integration, keeps execution and regulatory authorization risk live.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure plus dividends with a modest surplus, and free cash flow covers dividends, so distributions are funded internally rather than by borrowing. Buyback outflows are not disclosed, leaving total shareholder returns and their funding unknown.

Free cash flow to debt is slightly above the sector median but eased year over year, and cash flow to debt trails the median. Near-term maturities are modest relative to annual cash generation, and commercial paper programs provide backup liquidity, though refinancing remains recurring.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer combines high margins, solid interest coverage and self-funding dividends with leverage modestly above sector medians and a cash-flow-constrained indicative profile. Our judgement is a stable, investment-grade-like credit trajectory, contingent on sustained smoke-free growth and contained regulatory and litigation outcomes.

Liquidity is adequate but the current ratio sits marginally below one and slightly under the sector median, so working capital is tight. With maturities spread across the coming years and commercial paper access available, refinancing risk appears manageable, though reliance on rollover warrants monitoring.

credit_strengths.text: 經營利潤率約為消費必需品行業中位數的兩倍，並按年改善，反映香煙業務的定價能力以及無煙產品組合的規模化。此盈利質素支撐現金生成，並在可燃產品銷量下滑之際緩衝固定成本基礎。
利息覆蓋率按年改善，並穩居行業中位數之上，經營收入覆蓋總利息支出的倍數甚高。距下一風險區間的緩衝仍然充足，惟指示性概況受現金流而非盈利所限制。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿及淨槓桿略高於行業中位數，儘管兩者均按年緩和，距下一風險區間邊界的緩衝仍然偏薄。EBITDA 適度下滑或債務增加將推低指示性概況，因此去槓桿紀律至關重要。
業務仍面臨煙草及尼古丁產品固有的監管與訴訟風險，而披露文件警告並非所有風險因素均可預測。為商業化無煙產品（包括 Swedish Match 整合）的持續投資，使執行風險及監管授權風險持續存在。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 經營現金流覆蓋資本開支加股息後有溫和盈餘，自由現金流覆蓋股息，因此分派由內部資金支持而非借貸。回購流出未予披露，總股東回報及其資金來源仍然不明。
自由現金流對債務比率略高於行業中位數但按年緩和，現金流對債務比率則低於中位數。相對年度現金生成，近期到期債務規模不大，商業票據計劃提供備用流動性，惟再融資仍屬經常性。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人兼具高利潤率、穩健利息覆蓋及自我融資的股息，惟槓桿略高於行業中位數，指示性概況受現金流限制。我們的判斷為穩定、類投資級的信用軌跡，取決於無煙產品持續增長以及監管與訴訟結果受控。
流動性充足，惟流動比率略低於一且稍低於行業中位數，營運資金偏緊。鑑於到期債務分佈於未來數年且可動用商業票據，再融資風險似乎可控，惟對滾動再融資的依賴值得監察。
